earlier_failures_retained.resolution: Darwin 缺失 PID 的 sysctl 返回空结果，固定结构 helper 将其转 EIO；只在原始 sysctl 确认零长度时归类 ErrProcessGone，真实 I/O/权限仍失败。
首次同时启动时，快照目录的 mtime/size 检查把合法子目录创建当根替换；新增仅用于可变探测目录的 AnchorMutable，仍核对目录 inode/mode/symlink，普通文件与 explain 捕获保持原有完整检查。
本地 HTTP fixture 监听 127.0.0.1:0 被沙箱 EPERM 拒绝，58 过/1 错；仅按既有回环 fixture 约定放行采集器，随后 59/59，未删测或换 stub。
离线 observer fixture 绑定 /var 临时路径而生产捕获 /private/var 的 canonical 根；修正 fixture 根摘要，不放宽生产绑定。
Claude 预检用配置中的默认 timeout 推导显式 runner --timeout 参数，误拒绝合法安装；按实际 args 重建并交由现有 renderer 比较。
默认 timeout 修复后，SessionStart 的默认 120s 还需要保留 agenthooks 自身事件 Kind；补复用 kindToClaude，不复制原生事件表。
定向调查同一 SessionStart 默认 timeout/Kind 问题；现已补零/分数/显式 timeout 与默认 SessionStart 回归。
新普通 runner warn fixture 漏合法 model_body；按现有 schema 修正 fixture，未放宽 schema。
warn fixture 问题与真实信号测试发现的取消竞态：取消在轮询读取中到达时误判超时；补终止分支父 context 检查并保留确定性回归。
保留信号竞态定向调查失败；生产修复后真实 SIGINT/SIGTERM 和中途取消回归全部通过，临时调试观察已移除。

compatibility.old_binary_source: new git archive export and Go build for this task
compatibility.agenthooks_changes: read-only owner runtime subscription inspector using existing renderers/trust keys, bounded OS process birth and executable identity API; codec/config rendering ownership retained
compatibility.loopback_fixture: collector requires the established sandbox exception for 127.0.0.1 listener; failure and successful rerun both retained

boundaries.B1_C1: real_environment_pending; local process association is not authentication and does not exclude manual calls beneath harness ancestry
boundaries.Windows: D11/W1_pending; Darwin/Linux OS implementations, no Windows native acceptance
boundaries.execution: not-assessed even with valid index; callback observation can succeed with missing/bad index
boundaries.observer_budget: 5ms and at most six ancestors, no subprocess/full binary hash; asynchronous worker cannot extend hook exit wait and drops late/expired/changed observations
boundaries.ordinary_state_changes: real callbacks run the original engine and retain their ordinary state/stats/log updates
boundaries.process_origin: runtime identity from OS snapshot, live matching native birth/executable plus controller full file hashes; launcher/path/cache differences remain unverified
boundaries.recovery: only expired well-formed leases with verified owner exit or PID birth reuse; unreadable/malformed ownership stays unclaimed/busy, never blindly delete
